modifications: Product assets are unchanged. The static server and runtime apply the serving and navigation policies described in configuration.
configuration: server.py serves dist/ of the unmodified release archive at / and answers every path that is not a file of the site with index.html (the upstream nginx try_files rule); default build configuration, tracker and banners off. The static server applies CSP to the actual documents; the runtime checks final documents and restricts script navigation.
